messages:
maria: deploy-bot flagged a discrepancy during the eu-west canary - image tag `api-service:stable` has different digests between eu-west and us-east. can we pause eu-west canary?

deploy-bot: [AUTO] image-digest-mismatch detected for tag `api-service:stable`. eu-west: sha256:aaa111..., us-east: sha256:bbb222.... Suggest pinning to a specific digest or pausing region.

sam: ack. pausing eu-west canary now. setting canary pause until we decide. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jordan: do we know which registry mirror served the different digest? could be staging push earlier. either pin to one digest or roll back the few eu-west pods to the us-east digest.

ryan: quick safest path: pin the values for eu-west to the us-east digest (the one in prod). create a values override and do a targeted helm upgrade for the eu-west namespace. keep canary paused.

maria: I'll open a tiny PR with `values-eu-west/override.yaml` to set `image.digest: sha256:bbb222...` and a release note entry.

eng-release-bot: created PR #4123 -> "pin eu-west image digest due to registry inconsistency" (link: https://git.redwood/pr/4123). CI: quick lint + chart-validate.

sam: once PR merges, we'll do `helm upgrade --install api-service ./chart --namespace eu-west --set image.digest=sha256:bbb222... --reuse-values --wait` for the hotfix. keep replicas=2 for fast verification.

jordan: command we ran as a sanity check: ```bash
kubectl get pods -n eu-west -l app=api-service -o wide
NAME                               READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
api-service-5b6f7d6d9c-abcde       1/1     Running   0          30s
api-service-5b6f7d6d9c-fghij       1/1     Running   0          28s
```

ryan: and the image now: `gcr.io/redwood/api-service@sha256:bbb222...` on both eu-west pods. doing quick healthchecks against /health and a few sample requests.

maria: healthchecks green. will keep canary paused for 30m and monitor metrics (latency, error-rate, token throughput). adding note to release tracker: "hotfix: pin eu-west image digest to sha256:bbb222... due to registry mirror divergence"

sam: rollback plan if issues: `helm rollback api-service 1` (previous stable revision) and unpause traffic fallback to us-east. manual DB migration not involved.

jordan: also adding a follow-up action item for infra: check mirror sync between regions and registry GC jobs. assign to registry-team.

eng-release-bot: release note draft updated in changelog: "2026-03-20: hotfix - pinned eu-west image digest for api-service to avoid inconsistent registry mirrors."

ryan: thumbs up. after 30m, if metrics stable, we unpause eu-west and continue staggered roll to other regions to make sure tag==digest everywhere. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks everyone. I'll link the PR, screenshots, and the rollback commands into the incident ticket. closing thread once eu-west is fully unpaused.
